projections.branch_scope: Partial6-3E southern-France/Gulf-of-Lion-to-northern-Catalan westward-component context. Exclude upstream Corsican feeders/Ligurian basin reach,downstream40.6N bifurcation and Ibiza/Balearic branches,offshore eddies and inferred full Western Mediterranean circulation. Winds can rotate,weaken or fragment the westward jet;fixed270degree is not a curved along-slope axis. Berta2018 regional450m winter/250m summer scales are literature context,not December2011 or2022 paired boundaries,thickness or annual extrema. Narrow25-40km source-width context may be underresolved;native masks/support matter. Do not assign these cases as independent Ligurian segment measurements.
projections.interpolation_assumption: Keep every original fixed-longitude section in declared downstream order. Use selected native model positions;where no column qualifies,use actualnativewrappedlongitude and the declaredlatitude-gate midpoint only as an explicit unresolved reference geometry placeholder with no sampled position or depth. ShortestWGS84legs connect adjacentoriginal references,including across180/-180. Assume linear lowerdepth and paired modelspan only between neighboring original supported nodes;never skip,extrapolate or fill from an alternate cutoff. Distances are reference geometry,not measured current lengths.
